 The available secondary literature passages in the dossier reference the term *dibbacakkhu* solely as a general doctrinal category—such as one of the three or five types of "eyes" (*cakkhu*) or as a supernormal power (*abhijñā*) in the Nikāyas and later exegetical literature—rather than analyzing this specific *Kathāvatthu* chapter.

  DharmaNexus also traces 268 internal Pali reuse matches across 19 texts, most prominently with the structurally paired debate that follows it, the *Dibbasotakathā* (Kv 3.8; 21 matches spanning §4.1–10.2 and Kv 3.8 §3.4–10.2) [DharmaNexus]. Additional formulaic overlaps appear across other *Kathāvatthu* sections (such as Kv 16.4, Kv 1.1, Kv 4.3, Kv 1.6, and Kv 10.1), the commentary *Pañcapakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā*, and the *Niddesa* (Mnd 14, Mnd 16, Cnd 19) [DharmaNexus].
